title: At the pharmacy
setting: A pharmacy near the tram stop, with a sore throat.

lines.speaker: Lékárnice
lines.en: Hello, what can I do for you?

lines.speaker: Ty
lines.cs: Dobrý den, máte něco na bolest v krku?
lines.en: Hello, do you have anything for a sore throat?

lines.speaker: Lékárnice
lines.en: Do you also have a cough or a temperature?

lines.speaker: Ty
lines.cs: Ne, jen mě bolí v krku.

lines.speaker: Lékárnice
lines.cs: Tak tyhle pastilky. Jednu třikrát denně, nejdéle pět dní.
lines.en: Then these lozenges. One three times a day, for five days at most.

questions.prompt: How often should you take a lozenge?
options: Once a day for three days
questions.why: Třikrát denně: three times a day.

hints.explain: That would be každé tři hodiny.

hints.wrong: Once a day for three days
hints.explain: Jednou denně is once a day; she said třikrát denně.

questions.why: Máte i kašel nebo horečku? Do you also have a cough or a temperature?

hints.explain: A prescription is recept; lozenges don't need one.
You show that at the doctor's, not for lozenges.

answers: What can I do for you?
